profile.geoLocationName: Westhampton Beach, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer | Business Development Background | Full Stack Developer

After years in business development, I made the leap into software engineering—and I couldn't be more energized by the transition. My technical toolkit includes JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, HTML5, and CSS, but what really drives me is solving problems and building solutions that make a difference.

My business background taught me how to listen to clients, understand their pain points, and translate those needs into actionable solutions—skills that prove invaluable when developing user-focused applications. Whether I'm collaborating with cross-functional teams or diving into complex code, I bring the same curiosity and communication skills that served me well in business development.

Having lived and worked across different countries, I've learned to adapt quickly and see challenges from multiple angles. This global perspective helps me approach engineering problems creatively and work effectively with diverse teams.

I'm actively seeking opportunities to contribute to innovative full stack projects where I can blend my technical skills with my business acumen to create meaningful impact.

Focused on clean UX/UI design and client-side validation for seamless user experience

Optimized for SEO and performance through clean, maintainable code

Built performant SPAs with React, React Hooks, and React Router
Applied Object-Oriented Programming fundamentals for scalable architecture
Strengthened expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and accessibility-first design principles
Collaborated in an Agile team environment, utilizing GitHub and Git flow for code reviews

positions.title: Therapy Aide Supervisor/ Sober House Manager
positions.locationName: Westhampton Beach, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Held responsibility for the welfare of the clients and the protection of all Seafield Center property.
Transported and accompanied clients as necessary to outside appointments.
Ensured that all doors, entrances and exits are properly lighted by exit signs and also secured and locked upon the beginning of my shift.
Assisted the safety and proper protocol for 100 patients.
Monitored drug screening evaluations.
Assisted Clinical and Medical departments with client discharges.

Held house meetings once a week, and organized house responsibilities for residents. 
Accepted rents owed monthly, and encouraged clients to continue living a sober lifestyle. 
Ordered food and house supplies for 14 men. 
Reported directly to the Outpatient team and held communication with staff members. 
Enforced daily curfews and perfomed bed checks.
